projects.title: Fault-Tolerant Distributed Job Queue
projects.did: Designed and built the queue, the worker pool, the retry logic and a monitoring dashboard.
projects.hard: Keeping jobs moving when things break: retries with exponential backoff, and a dead-letter path for jobs that keep failing.
projects.outcome: 50 jobs/sec at 97% success under simulated failures and burst traffic. The dashboard tracks throughput, p95 latency, failure rate and queue depth.

projects.title: AI Dataset Doctor
projects.did: Built a modular pipeline that audits and cleans image datasets, with configurable batch processing. Beyond the basic checks, it clusters similar images and validates labels.
projects.hard: Spotting corrupted files, duplicates, blur and low-resolution images, then quarantining them without destroying anything. On top of that, clustering groups similar images and label validation catches mislabeled samples.

projects.title: Document Layout Recognition
projects.did: Implemented CNN-based layout analysis in TensorFlow for multi-class structural segmentation.
projects.hard: Telling the parts of a page apart, such as text, figures and tables, and getting accuracy up through annotated training data and hyperparameter tuning.

projects.title: Database Deployment Automation
projects.did: Built a Python framework that automates SQL DDL execution on SQL Server.
projects.hard: Handling GO-separated batches, complex DDL, and SQL Server’s rule that CREATE DATABASE can’t run inside a transaction.
projects.outcome: Every deployment (script, timestamp, duration, status, errors) lands in a central audit table, which replaced manual deployments nobody could trace.
